channel.title: Kept Hour
channel.description: Salary arithmetic after tax, commute, and meetings. One number per item. Planning tool, not tax advice.

item.title: The raise that lowers the hour
item.description: $70,000 at 40 hours keeps $26.25. $90,000 at 55 hours keeps $24.55. Same tax, same weeks, no commute.

item.title: Five extra hours is 250 hours a year
item.description: At $90,000 the kept hour falls from $33.75 to $30.00. The salary does not move.

item.title: A 40-minute commute is 167 hours a year
item.description: Unpaid is not free. Price the seat at the kept hour.

item.title: Eight meeting hours a week is 400 hours a year
item.description: If the series produces no decision you can name, that is the number in the decline.

item.title: Dividing by 2,080 hides the week
item.description: $90,000 at the hours you actually work is not the LinkedIn hourly.

item.title: Software engineer, typical week
item.description: A typical $128,000 at 45 hours. Change the hours if the week is worse.
